q: Your crew hoists this small ball, bought for a dinghy. Does it meet Annex I for your yacht?
answer: No — from 20 m a ball is at least 0.6 m across
why: Annex I 6: a ball is at least 0.6 m in diameter; only a vessel under 20 m may use smaller shapes to suit her size.
